description: Request access to a vendor trust center (SafeBase or Vanta only; requires trustlists_login). Resolves the vendor in the public directory, creates a vendor review if needed, then queues the request. First call previews. Call again with confirm: true to submit. If the requester profile is incomplete, update it with trustlists_requester_profile first.

confirm.description: Must be true to enqueue. Omit to preview.

name: trustlists_access_request
